name: harness-event-assistant-delta
notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:391 and 9-11: streaming deltas are best effort and are never replayed, so a delta carries no seq at all (AgentHarness.swift:414-415, 453). DSH yields text-delta chunks with seq absent (DSHRemoteHarness.swift:350-364). A host that persists deltas as durable events breaks the resume contract.
